ui.install.title: Install Lockerdex
ui.install.intro: Put Lockerdex on your home screen: it opens like an app, full screen, and works offline.
ui.install.ios: iPhone and iPad (Safari): tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”.
ui.install.android: Android (Chrome): open the ⋮ menu and tap “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.
ui.install.desktop: Computer (Chrome or Edge): click the install icon at the end of the address bar.
ui.install.done: Lockerdex installed. Look for it on your home screen.

cheatmaster.label: Cheat Master
cheatmaster.bonus: Button mash: every input counts as correct when entering the cheat codes found on the map.

hacker.label: Loot Hacker
hacker.bonus: Raises the chance of spawning items from your Loot Hacks.

reaper.label: Bounty Hunter
reaper.bonus: Chance to find sprites when you eliminate opponents. Only earns sprite XP from eliminations, unless the sprite has its own XP rules.

galaxy.label: Galaxy
galaxy.bonus: +30% ammo picked up on the map.

holofoil.label: Holofoil
holofoil.bonus: 5% chance for your squad to find rare sprite variants when looting chests.

quack.label: Quack
quack.bonus: Boosts every Sprite you carry with extra Sprite XP whenever they gain XP.

Crown.name: Crown
ability: Levels up only by winning matches — faster with Crown Wins.
Mastering it unlocks new variants.

Klombo.name: Klombo
ability: Gives random items at each level and only levels up when you consume items.
Item quality improves with each level.

CosmicThunderDoubleJump.name: Jackrabbit
ability: Active — jump in the air for a double jump.
Less cooldown between jumps with each level.

WinnerB.name: X-Ray
ability: Periodically marks enemies around you.
Marks more often and in a wider radius with each level.

Killswitch.name: Killswitch
ability: Active — aim in the air to enter Hangtime with better accuracy.
Accuracy improves with each level.

BodySlam.name: Crash Bandicoot
ability: Active — jump in the air to spin into a whirlwind that damages and knocks back nearby enemies.
More damage and less cooldown with each level.

GhostDamage.name: Blinky
ability: Cloaks you for a moment whenever you take damage.
The cloak lasts longer with each level.

NarrowFlea.name: Sonic
ability: Gotta go fast! You sprint faster with each level.

NarrowFleaMonkey.name: Tails
ability: Active — jump in the air to hover with Tails' help.
Hover speed rises with each level.

ReloadOverTime.name: Shadow
ability: Automatically reloads the weapons you're not holding.
At max level it also reloads the equipped weapon.
Auto-reload gets faster with each level.

WinnerA.name: Pond
ability: Active — jump right after landing to Super Jump, if you have a charge.
Charges come back over time.
Stronger jump and shorter cooldown with each level.

Overshield.name: Overshield
ability: Grants an overshield that grows with its level.

IncreaseHeals.name: Morgana
ability: Healing items work better.
Effectiveness rises with each level.

BushRanger.name: Bush
ability: After a while, covers you with a bush. At max level, eliminations also give you a bush.
Time between bushes drops with each level.

Dwarf.name: Adventure
ability: Upgrades a random item in your inventory at each level.

Jonesy.name: Jonesy
ability: Restores some health or shield shortly after you take damage.
Heals more with each level.

8BitBlaster.name: 8-Bit
ability: You find an 8-Bit Shotgun in your first chest and get a score multiplier with it.

StormScout.name: Storm Scout
ability: Applies Overdrive after you take a certain amount of Storm damage.
Overdrive lasts longer with each level.

ImprovedSlide.name: Mega Man
ability: Slide with less friction.
Slide farther with each level.

WinnerC.name: Onigiri
ability: Applies Overdrive after you eat or drink a consumable.
Overdrive lasts longer with each level.

Birthday.name: Birthday
ability: Opening chests can spawn a slice of cake.
At max level, eliminations can spawn cake too.
Cake chance rises with each level.

FillerGrunt.name: John Wick
ability: Knocking a player reveals others nearby.

Batman.name: Batman
ability: Lets you launch into the air and deploy the Bat Cape.

Water.name: Water
ability: Restores shield while you stand in water.

Earth.name: Earth
ability: Chance to find extra rare items when opening chests.

Spitfire.name: Fire
ability: Releases a fiery burst once you deal enough damage to an enemy.

Duck.name: Duck
ability: Emoting or jamming restores shield.

Ghost.name: Ghost
ability: Cloaks you for a while when you reload.

Sleepy.name: Dream
ability: Gives a random item at each level and bursts with legendary loot at max level.
Loot improves with each level.

Demon.name: Demon
ability: Siphons health and shield when you eliminate an opponent.

Punk.name: Punk
ability: Possibly nothing… or infinitely something.

King.name: King
ability: Your pickaxe deals more damage.

CokeParmesan.name: Vini Jr.
ability: Sprinting for a while makes your slide destructive.
Hitting enemies with a slide raises fire rate and reload speed.

BurntPeanut.name: Burnt Peanut
ability: Goop! Eliminating players may drop extra loot — sometimes Mythic (10% at max level).

ZeroPoint.name: Zero Point
ability: Spawns a Shield Bubble Jr. when you use a healing item on yourself (not splashes or grenades).

Fishy.name: Fishy
ability: Swim much faster, and taking damage briefly speeds you up.

Soccer.name: Striker
ability: Gain Overdrive when you mantle, hurdle or wall scramble.

Drifter.name: Aura
ability: Gain a Shock Rock charge once you deal enough damage to enemies.

Boss.name: Boss
ability: Raises your max health and shield.

Grim.name: Grim
ability: Whoever attacks you gets marked for a while.

Air.name: Air
ability: Sprint faster and jump higher.
Cancels fall damage.
Jumps get higher with each level.

Seven.name: Seven
ability: Enemy footprints become visible to your squad.

PedicureAntacid.name: Ironmouse
ability: Regenerates health when you're low.
While regenerating, gain cloak and low gravity.

CompanyStargazer.name: Pollo
ability: After an elimination, slowly restores shield for you and nearby squadmates.

Llama.name: Lootin' Llama
ability: Opening ammo boxes can grant a weapon upgrade.

Peely.name: Peeky Peely
ability: Sends a ping that reveals players with rare sprites nearby, but marks you on the map.

PhaseDash.name: Spooky Dash
ability: Active — jump in the air to phase through some objects.
Gains charges over time.
Less wait between charges with each level.

HealthSiphon.name: Vampire
ability: Recover health when you damage an enemy.
The percentage recovered grows with each level.

IncreasedMelee.name: The Deer
ability: Melee attacks deal more damage.
Melee damage grows with each level.

WinnerD.name: Dumpster Dive
ability: Food gives bonus healing.
Find food when you leap out of hiding props, and with a small chance when opening containers.
Better food with each level.

WinnerE.name: Honey
ability: Chance to spawn bees at the impact location when you deal damage with a ranged weapon.

CargoLying.name: One Wish Willow
ability: Extract enemies' equipped Sprites when you eliminate them, and push nearby enemies away when you take damage.
You're marked on the map if you remove it, so be careful!
